subject.title: feat(models): use provider/name as internal key to decouple from API model ID

question: Should OpenClaw introduce a model-profile/API-id decoupling contract here, and should that contract repurpose provider/name, add an explicit routed profile/API-id field, or defer the change?
rationale: The gap is source-reproducible, but the choice defines public model identity and upgrade behavior across config, sessions, providers, and UI, so code inspection alone cannot choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Use an explicit routed profile contract
options.body: Add a clear profile-to-upstream mapping such as routeTo or apiModelId, preserving name as display metadata and pairing it with doctor migration and docs.

options.title: Repurpose provider/name
options.body: Adopt the issue's proposal directly, but accept the migration and UI semantics risk from changing name from display metadata to identity.

options.title: Defer the contract
options.body: Keep current provider/model identity and close or split only narrower bugs that can be fixed without a new model-profile surface.

recommendation.title: Use an explicit routed profile contract
recommendation.body: Add a clear profile-to-upstream mapping such as routeTo or apiModelId, preserving name as display metadata and pairing it with doctor migration and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is adjacent work on provider/model identity, alias resolution, and config-contract documentation.
